name: electric-guitar
about: An electric guitar as its pickup hears it, after a Fender's raw pickup signal: picked near the bridge, a seventh of the way along, so the seventh harmonic and its multiples are missing; ringing long, the low strings longest (a 60 dB fall in about 30 s on E2, 12 s on E4), its highs dying first. A magnetic pickup hears the string's speed, not where it is, so its harmonics rise 6 dB an octave up to the pickup's own resonance near 4 kHz and fall away past it: a band pass there, which leaves the fundamental under the third and fourth harmonics as the guitar's own is. Meant for a group with a Distortion
